sql.query: SELECT 'workflow' contextType,w.id contextId,w.workflowName contextName,c.id conversationId,COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_chat_messages msg WHERE msg.tenantId=w.tenantId AND msg.conversationId=c.id AND msg.isDeleted=0 AND msg.id>COALESCE(cp.lastReadMessageId,0)),0) unreadCount FROM tbl_workflows w LEFT JOIN tbl_chat_conversations c ON c.tenantId=w.tenantId AND c.conversationType='workflow' AND c.workflowId=w.id AND c.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_chat_participants cp ON cp.tenantId=w.tenantId AND cp.conversationId=c.id AND cp.userId=:userId WHERE w.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='TEAM_CHAT' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=w.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='chat.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId2 AND utr.tenantId=w.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY w.modifiedDate DESC,w.workflowName LIMIT 200

SELECT 'team' contextType,t.id contextId,t.teamName contextName,c.id conversationId,COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_chat_messages msg WHERE msg.tenantId=t.tenantId AND msg.conversationId=c.id AND msg.isDeleted=0 AND msg.id>COALESCE(cp.lastReadMessageId,0)),0) unreadCount FROM tbl_teams t LEFT JOIN tbl_chat_conversations c ON c.tenantId=t.tenantId AND c.conversationType='team' AND c.teamId=t.id AND c.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_chat_participants cp ON cp.tenantId=t.tenantId AND cp.conversationId=c.id AND cp.userId=:userId WHERE t.tenantId=:tenantId AND t.isActive=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tenantModule INNER JOIN tbl_modules module ON module.id=tenantModule.moduleId AND module.moduleCode='TEAM_CHAT' AND module.isActive=1 WHERE tenantModule.tenantId=t.tenantId AND tenantModule.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:adminUser AND utr.tenantId=t.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_team_members member ON member.userTenantId=ut.id AND member.tenantId=ut.tenantId AND member.teamId=t.id AND member.isActive=1 WHERE ut.userId=:memberUser AND ut.tenantId=t.tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active')) ORDER BY t.teamName
